name: distribution-decisions
body: Distribution decisions [with user]: (1) platforms are macOS arm64/amd64 and Windows amd64/arm64 only; Linux is an explicit non-goal. (2) Binaries are published as GitHub Releases assets on the private repo. (3) macOS installs via a Homebrew tap using HOMEBREW_GITHUB_API_TOKEN and a custom download strategy in the tap; Windows via a Scoop bucket. Scoop has no native auth-header support, so the manifest/installer must work around it (e.g. a pre-install script using the token); the exact mechanism is left to implementation. Install docs must explain token setup. (4) CI is GitHub Actions: every release runs offline `eypres init && eypres start` e2e on native runners for all four targets (cross-compile alone is insufficient); a tag-triggered release workflow builds, publishes and updates the formula/manifest (version + checksums). (5) Humans push and tag; agents never do (global.constraint.humans-push-and-tag). The single-binary AC now requires native CI verification. The single-binary → supported-platforms and native-ci-verification → single-binary depends-on edges are [autonomous].
